episode.title: Tiny Tadpole, Beautiful Frog 🐸

shots.scene: Beautiful nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. shots.action: Present the mature, tailless frog in a graceful resting pose, with beautifully detailed mottled brown skin, folded hind legs and a sharply focused golden eye. Its larger adult form fills the frame impressively.

episode.description: From a jelly-coated egg to a beautiful frog, watch one tiny life transform in a peaceful pond. #GlowUpNature #FrogLifeCycle #Metamorphosis #NatureMacro #NatureShorts
